# growthbook_project (Data Source)

Looks up a GrowthBook project by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "growthbook_project" "example" {
  id = "prj_abc123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) GrowthBook project id (`prj_...`).

### Read-Only

- `date_created` (String) RFC3339 timestamp the project was created.
- `date_updated` (String) RFC3339 timestamp the project was last updated.
- `description` (String) Description of the project.
- `name` (String) Display name of the project.
- `public_id` (String) Stable identifier used in feature flag payloads.
- `restrict_access` (Boolean) Whether this project is restricted to explicitly granted members.
- `settings` (Attributes) Per-project statistics settings overriding the organization defaults. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))

<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Read-Only:

- `confidence_level` (Number) Confidence level required to call a winner.
- `p_value_threshold` (Number) P-value threshold for statistical significance.
- `stats_engine` (String) Statistics engine, e.g. `bayesian` or `frequentist`.
